relationship: Revised HR-stage interaction detail for the owner-approved loops-single-spine-dossier-v4.png

interactionContract.unit: One interview question is one inline accordion card.
interactionContract.compact: Question title, explicit owner assessment, and expand affordance remain visible.
interactionContract.expanded: Question context, My approach, and My review remain together inside the selected card; no verbatim-answer reconstruction.
interactionContract.siblings: Only the selected question expands; sibling cards remain compact and move in normal flow.
interactionContract.roundLevel: Superseded: the final owner-approved stage does not render round-level self-assessment or interviewer-feedback cards.
interactionContract.truth: All populated values are explicitly illustrative and must not be treated as saved interview history.
